record.name: 内阁满票签档子房
pinyin: nei ge man piao qian dang zi fang
man piao qian dang zi fang

summary.zh: 满票签档子房是清代内阁收存满文档案的机构。故宫博物院《内阁大堂》条目将其记在内阁大学士斋宿区东侧；独立建筑边界及现状尚未核实。
summary.en: The Manchu Archives Room was an office of the Qing Grand Secretariat for keeping Manchu-language archives. The Palace Museum article on Neige Main Hall places it east of the grand secretaries’ lodging area; its independent building boundaries and present condition have not been verified.

evidenceNote.zh: 官方条目正文确认名称与相对位置，同页“满票签档子房”释义说明其用途。它与“满票签房”分别列名；本条不推定间数、朝向、屋顶、尺寸或现存形体。
evidenceNote.en: The official article identifies the name and relative location, and its glossary entry for the Manchu Archives Room explains the function. It is listed separately from the Manpiao Qian Room; no bay count, orientation, roof, dimensions or surviving form is inferred here.

modelNote.zh: 本条仅提供历史信息，未绑定独立模型或地图位置，不提供直达。
modelNote.en: This is an information-only entry. No independent model or map position is bound, and direct travel is unavailable.

siteAccess.zh: 现场开放与入内安排尚未核实。
siteAccess.en: Current visitor access and entry arrangements have not been verified.

sources.title: 内阁大堂
sources.shortPrimaryQuote: 堂后为内阁大学士斋宿之所，其东为满票签档子房、典籍厅。
sources.glossaryQuote: 清代内阁专司收存满文档案之处。
